subject.title: fix(automerge): merge ready behind heads directly

question: Should automerge permit a `BEHIND` pull request to merge based on exact-head checks alone, or require validation of the current merge result first?
rationale: This is a cross-repository merge-safety policy choice: the patch intentionally trades base-integration validation for avoiding rebase-induced unrelated failures, and the correct default cannot be inferred from the diff alone.

options.title: Require merge-result validation
options.body: Accept `BEHIND` only after checks or an equivalent trusted proof cover the merge with the current base, preserving direct merge where that evidence exists.

options.title: Accept exact-head-only merges
options.body: Allow the proposed behavior and explicitly accept that repository policy and GitHub’s merge operation, rather than ClawSweeper validation, own base-integration risk.

recommendation.title: Require merge-result validation
recommendation.body: Accept `BEHIND` only after checks or an equivalent trusted proof cover the merge with the current base, preserving direct merge where that evidence exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the automerge policy change and its operational rationale.
